title: Optimize an Expensive Search or Dashboard
objectives: Optimize an Expensive Search or Dashboard
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Run index=ops_logs | sort service | stats count by status and inspect its work in Job Inspector. The sort is unnecessary for this aggregation; record its result values and time window.

Run index=ops_logs | stats count by status over the same range and inspect it. Verify equivalent status counts with less measured work. Explain why removing an unnecessary sort is useful and why deterministic work units are not a production latency benchmark.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
